question_text_en: Do requirements/design changes follow the ECR→ECN process with cost, schedule, and quality impact assessments?

question_text_en: Do BOMs, drawings, and firmware use a single source of truth with access control in PLM/ALM?

question_id: change-样机-批次与版本是否可双向追溯-where-used-as-built
question_text_zh: 样机/批次与版本是否可双向追溯（Where Used/As-built）？
question_text_en: Can prototypes/batches trace versions bi-directionally (Where Used/As-built)?

question_id: change-对客户-生产-供应商的-pcn-scn-通知机制是否明确且可审计
question_text_zh: 对客户/生产/供应商的 PCN/SCN 通知机制是否明确且可审计？
question_text_en: Is the PCN/SCN notification process to customers, manufacturing, and suppliers defined and auditable?

module_name_zh: 3. 设计质量与可靠性（含前期物料选型与准入）

question_id: design-3-1-静电-浪涌与系统级保护-esd-surge
question_text_zh: 是否在设计阶段明确各接口/关键器件的系统级 ESD/Surge 目标并完成方案验证（含带电插拔/瞬变），且设计变更会触发复核？
question_text_en: Do we define system-level ESD/Surge targets per interface or critical component, validate the solution (including hot-plug/transients), and trigger revalidation whenever the design changes?

module_name_zh: 3. 设计质量与可靠性（含前期物料选型与准入）
module_name_en: 3. Design Quality & Reliability (Early Component Selection & Qualification)
question_id: design-3-2-电源完整性与-wcca-worst-case
question_text_zh: 关键电源回路是否完成 WCCA/环路稳定性评估（含 Bode/相位裕量/增益裕量/容差叠加），并形成可追溯记录？
question_text_en: Have critical power loops completed WCCA/loop stability analysis (Bode, phase/gain margins, tolerance stacks) with traceable records?

module_name_zh: 3. 设计质量与可靠性（含前期物料选型与准入）
module_name_en: 3. Design Quality & Reliability (Early Component Selection & Qualification)
question_id: design-3-3-pdn-si-pi-联合仿真
question_text_zh: 是否建立 PDN 目标阻抗并完成 SI/PI 联合仿真与板测相关性校核，对高速/大电流轨有明确去耦与布局约束？
question_text_en: Have we defined PDN target impedance, completed SI/PI co-simulation with board correlation, and set explicit decoupling/layout constraints for high-speed and high-current rails?

module_name_zh: 3. 设计质量与可靠性（含前期物料选型与准入）
module_name_en: 3. Design Quality & Reliability (Early Component Selection & Qualification)
question_id: design-3-4-结构应力-冲击-密封-fea-ip
question_text_zh: 是否完成结构 FEA 与关键工况（跌落/扭转/挤压/密封压缩量等）验证，并与型式试验（如 IP 等级）一致？
question_text_en: Have we completed structural FEA and key-condition validation (drop/twist/compression/seal squeeze) and aligned with type tests such as IP ratings?

module_name_zh: 3. 设计质量与可靠性（含前期物料选型与准入）
module_name_en: 3. Design Quality & Reliability (Early Component Selection & Qualification)
question_id: design-3-5-热设计与电-热协同-cfd
question_text_zh: 是否进行稳态与瞬态热仿真并与实测对比，明确节流/降额策略与结温/触感控制目标？
question_text_en: Do we run steady-state and transient thermal simulations, compare against measurements, and define throttling/derating strategies plus junction/touch temperature targets?

module_name_zh: 3. 设计质量与可靠性（含前期物料选型与准入）
module_name_en: 3. Design Quality & Reliability (Early Component Selection & Qualification)
question_id: design-3-6-射频-天线仿真与-ota-预算
question_text_zh: 是否建立射频/天线性能/TRP/TIS 预算并完成 EM 仿真与 OTA 实测相关性校核，且结构变更具备复核机制？
question_text_en: Have we built RF/antenna performance and TRP/TIS budgets, correlated EM simulations with OTA measurements, and established rechecks for structural changes?

module_name_zh: 3. 设计质量与可靠性（含前期物料选型与准入）
module_name_en: 3. Design Quality & Reliability (Early Component Selection & Qualification)
question_id: design-3-7-条件触发的必要仿真-按-dfmea-高风险触发
question_text_zh: 是否基于 DFMEA/风险评估定义条件触发的专项验证（如耐腐蚀/化学品/高低温循环等），并将其纳入设计 Entry/Exit？
question_text_en: Have we defined DFMEA/risk-triggered special verifications (corrosion, chemicals, thermal cycling, etc.) and wired them into design Entry/Exit gates?

question_id: org-1-组织边界与职责清晰度-r-r-跨团队接口-是否有正式组织架构-跨团队接口定义与升级路径
question_text_zh: #1 组织边界与职责清晰度（R&R、跨团队接口） 是否有正式组织架构、跨团队接口定义与升级路径？
question_text_en: #1 Organizational boundaries & role clarity (R&R, cross-team interfaces): Do we maintain a formal org structure, defined interfaces, and escalation paths?

question_id: org-2-关键岗位胜任力矩阵-rf-camera-emc-热-可靠性-关键岗位是否具备胜任力矩阵与资格认证
question_text_zh: #2 关键岗位胜任力矩阵（RF/Camera/EMC/热/可靠性） 关键岗位是否具备胜任力矩阵与资格认证？
question_text_en: #2 Critical-role competency matrix (RF/Camera/EMC/Thermal/Reliability): Do critical roles maintain competency matrices and certifications?

question_id: org-4-领域覆盖与-dri-清单-子系统命名-dri-权限-是否维护子系统-dri-清单及权限边界
question_text_zh: #4 领域覆盖与 DRI 清单（子系统命名 DRI、权限） 是否维护子系统 DRI 清单及权限边界？
question_text_en: #4 Domain coverage & DRI roster (subsystem owners, authority): Is the subsystem DRI list maintained with clear authority boundaries?

question_id: org-5-技术治理与决策边界-drb-ccb-stop-build-建议权-技术治理机制是否有效运行
question_text_zh: #5 技术治理与决策边界（DRB/CCB、Stop-Build 建议权） 技术治理机制是否有效运行？
question_text_en: #5 Technical governance & decision boundaries (DRB/CCB, stop-build authority): Does the technical governance mechanism operate effectively?

question_id: perf-是否设定并跟踪研发-kpi-一期通过率-缺陷密度-按期率-返工率-rma-ppm
question_text_zh: 是否设定并跟踪研发 KPI（一期通过率/缺陷密度/按期率/返工率/RMA/ppm）？
question_text_en: Do we define and track R&D KPIs (first-pass yield, defect density, on-time rate, rework rate, RMA, ppm)?

question_id: perf-是否开展项目复盘-ll-lessons-learned-并沉淀为设计与工艺标准
question_text_zh: 是否开展项目复盘/LL（Lessons Learned）并沉淀为设计与工艺标准？
question_text_en: Do we run project retrospectives/Lessons Learned and feed them into design and process standards?

question_id: process-是否有端到端-npi-流程-需求-架构-设计-验证-移交-并落实职责分工
question_text_zh: 是否有端到端 NPI 流程（需求→架构→设计→验证→移交），并落实职责分工？
question_text_en: Do we run an end-to-end NPI process (requirements → architecture → design → verification → handover) with clear role ownership?

question_id: process-是否建立研发设计规范库-pcb-esd-射频-结构等-并保持版本可追溯
question_text_zh: 是否建立研发设计规范库（PCB、ESD、射频、结构等）并保持版本可追溯？
question_text_en: Do we maintain a controlled design standards library (PCB, ESD, RF, mechanical, etc.) with version traceability?

question_id: process-对外部输入-客户-法规-pcn-是否建立变更感知与落地机制
question_text_zh: 对外部输入（客户/法规/PCN）是否建立变更感知与落地机制？
question_text_en: Do we maintain a mechanism to sense and implement external inputs (customer, regulatory, PCN)?

question_text_zh: 是否为关键风险建立 Plan B/C（替代方案/降级策略/二供切换）并有演练记录？

question_text_zh: 是否进行跨部门 DFM/DFA 评审（RD/ME/PE/QA/SCM），并确保结论整改闭环？

question_text_zh: 早期供应商参与（ESI）：产能/交期/生命周期/替代评估是否纳入设计约束？

question_text_zh: 关键物料二供策略是否在设计阶段完成等效性验证（功能/可靠性/一致性）？
question_text_en: Does the second-source strategy validate equivalence (function/reliability/consistency) during design?

module_name_zh: 5. 研发与供应链协同（DFM/DFA/早期导入）
module_name_en: 5. R&D and Supply Chain Collaboration (DFM/DFA/Early Involvement)
question_id: scm-试产前工装-治具-ict-fct-需求与验收标准是否明确并完成验收
question_text_zh: 试产前工装/治具/ICT/FCT 需求与验收标准是否明确并完成验收？
question_text_en: Are pilot-build tooling/fixtures/ICT/FCT requirements defined with acceptance criteria and completed acceptance?

question_id: verify-是否建立覆盖功能-性能-可靠性-合规的测试矩阵-并与-entry-exit-对齐
question_text_zh: 是否建立覆盖功能/性能/可靠性/合规的测试矩阵，并与 Entry/Exit 对齐？
question_text_en: Do we have a test matrix covering function, performance, reliability, and compliance that aligns with Entry/Exit gates?

question_id: verify-是否具备关键实验室-仪器-emc-安规-esd-热像-相机-sfr-射频-或合格外部实验室
question_text_zh: 是否具备关键实验室/仪器（EMC/安规/ESD/热像/相机 SFR/射频）或合格外部实验室？
question_text_en: Do we have critical labs/instruments (EMC, safety, ESD, thermal imaging, camera SFR, RF) or qualified external labs?

question_id: verify-是否开展环境与寿命测试-alt-高低温循环-高湿-盐雾-汗液-并建立寿命预测模型
question_text_zh: 是否开展环境与寿命测试（ALT/高低温循环/高湿/盐雾/汗液），并建立寿命预测模型？
question_text_en: Do we run environmental and life tests (ALT, thermal cycling, high humidity, salt fog, sweat) and build a life prediction model?

question_id: verify-rf-ota-暗室是否能完成-trp-tis-测试-仿真与实测的相关性如何证明
question_text_zh: RF/OTA 暗室是否能完成 TRP/TIS 测试？仿真与实测的相关性如何证明？
question_text_en: Can the RF/OTA chamber complete TRP/TIS testing, and how is correlation to simulation demonstrated?

question_id: verify-相机实验室是否能出具-mtf-sfr-oecf-畸变-杂散光-ois-af-寿命完整报告
question_text_zh: 相机实验室是否能出具 MTF/SFR、OECF、畸变、杂散光、OIS/AF 寿命完整报告？
question_text_en: Can the camera lab deliver complete MTF/SFR, OECF, distortion, stray light, and OIS/AF life reports?
